pos.why: static low: is the fan stopped or just running low? Reading is kept for every room on this AHU

preamble.why: two or more rooms on one AHU: look at the shared parent once. Static OK means the fan is running, so skip the fan read

pos.why: static low and fan off/tripped: two AHU points agree
my own gauge at the box inlet agrees

neg.why: BAS says low, my gauge disagrees: probably supply but not confirmed
AHU static low with the fan running: gauge the box inlet myself before blaming supply

pos.why: static low: fan stopped, or running and just low?

neg.why: BAS alarm but lights look healthy

pos.why: BAS says offline or alarming: look at the lights before I believe it

neg.why: BAS shows a bad setpoint or schedule but the wall unit looks fine

pos.why: BAS says setpoint, schedule or mode is wrong: confirm at the wall with a reference thermometer

neg.why: inlet static low with the fan running

pos.why: inlet static low: fan off or just low static?
my gauge disagrees with the controller, or ports and tubes are bad

neg.why: box, sensing, linkage and duct all look right: leaves config I cannot read
box is healthy and feeds the room: last look is the flex and diffuser
damper moves but is it reaching full open?
K-factor against the nameplate

pos.why: box feeds the room but the diffuser airflow is off: sensor path next

neg.why: damper moves, inlet static fine, no airflow response at this diffuser and the duct is clean: drawings are suspect
does the diffuser respond when I drive this box to full cooling?

pos.why: damper moves, so gauge the inlet
meter says no 24 VAC at the actuator

neg.why: controller alive, powered, no signal at the actuator

pos.why: no signal: is the controller alive?
diffuser airflow rose, so 'does not move' was a bad read: this is not an actuator

neg.why: powered, signal present, shaft free, linkage good, no motion and no airflow response
last cross-check before I condemn an actuator
powered, signalled and free: is the linkage slipping?
powered and signalled but not moving: turn the shaft by hand
power is good, so is the command reaching the actuator?
damper does not move: meter the actuator first

pos.why: airflow at the diffuser is off: does the damper move when commanded?

neg.why: BAS flags the valve, inspection shows nothing

pos.why: look at the valve or element myself before condemning it
a judgement call, not a measurement

neg.why: everything I can read is normal; the minimum or schedule settings are what I cannot see
watch the loop for 5 minutes
is the room now asking for more than the box was sized for?
max airflow setpoint against design
airflow is as it should be, so heat or setpoints
air is arriving as expected: check the sensor against a reference
my own flow hood tells me whether air reaches the room as the box should be delivering
cheap BAS look at setpoint, schedule and mode
is the box alive on the network? Its other points are not worth reading if it is not

root.why: AHU static first (free if already read): fan off or low static explains everything downstream
